alerts.headline: APL Apollo Tubes shares plunge 15%, Tata Steel falls 6% as Rs 5,825 crore block deal follows acquisition news
alerts.summary: APL Apollo Tubes shares plunged 15% and Tata Steel fell 6% after a Rs 5,825 crore block deal involving nearly 10% of APL Apollo's equity, following Tata Steel's announcement of a potential Rs 32,266 crore acquisition.
second_order_candidates: Winner: block-deal buyers who took the stock at the discount; see [9d1d3c869d15].

Losers: same as [9d1d3c869d15]; the move has deepened since 09:46 (APL -10% to -15%, Tata Steel -4% to -6%), so the market is pricing both financing strain at Tata Steel and a weaker APL float, not a one-off dip.
Catalyst: surprise - same-day block deal; next dated step is the open-offer window (dates not read).
Thesis fit: none (no draft: terms and open-offer dates unverified, and the move is already in prices).

alerts.headline: Shriram Finance set to join Sensex as Trent exits on December 21
alerts.summary: On the BSE, the stock was trading at ₹1,000.45 on November 23, up 2.72% from its previous close of ₹974, touching an intraday high of ₹1,015
second_order_candidates: Winner: Shriram Finance (SHRIRAMFIN) - passive funds tracking the Sensex must buy it before the 21 December rebalance, so demand is forced and mechanical.
Losers: Trent (TRENT) - the same funds must sell it; the selling is non-informational but real. Other index names lose a sliver of weight (small).

Catalyst: scheduled - Sensex rebalance effective 21 December (a Sunday, so trades settle on the Friday before); index-inclusion flows are widely front-run, so much may already be priced after the announcement.
Thesis fit: none. No draft: the size of passive flow is not known to me and a front-run window already open makes entry late; rated close to a coin flip.

alerts.headline: Tata Steel dips 7% as APL Apollo tumbles on ₹28,000 crore deal; Hindalco also under pressure
alerts.summary: The proposed transactions include the sale of Tata Steel’s tubes business for up to ₹11,700 crore and its 100% stake in Tata Steel Colors for ₹16,300 crore.
second_order_candidates: Winner: none clear. Deal value of Rs 28,000 crore is the headline figure; the filing itself was not readable here.

Losers: Hindalco (HINDALCO) is named as "also under pressure" but the article gives no mechanism I could verify (likely sector or index drag, not deal exposure); JSW Steel (JSWSTEEL) and Jindal Saw (JINDALSAW) face a better-funded coated/tubes rival. Mechanism inferred, not confirmed.
Catalyst: surprise - same event as [ebf86f5aeb1e]; follow-ups are the investor meet and the open-offer window.
Thesis fit: none
